rules.description: A van carries at most 120 trays this week (its racks hold 120).
Vans leave no earlier than 05:00 and are back at the kitchen by 10:00.
No delivery to the café that is closed this week (South Hill café (C11)).
Every open café receives all its trays in exactly one visit.
Partner-brand cafés (chilled products) are served only by the refrigerated van.
On every route, premium cafés are visited before standard cafés.
